headline: Brentwood School coach Gareth Stafford Bull likely abused pupils, review finds
summary: The school's own independent review says the fencing coach probably harmed a number of boys through the 1980s and 1990s, and that former pupils who came forward years later were brushed off. British Fencing is now launching its own inquiry.
